Effects mode tests cycle<fresh uniform1..1000: first 1/8 branch is overlay-only; else fresh1/2 branch may spawn native LightningBolt at recipient block when Scorpioid advancement/map flag, armor>1 and fresh1/20; final else applies Blindness60/1, Darkness60/1, Poison200/1 independently of hurt. Then100 random candidate positions, XYZ inclusive[-40,40], require empty current/nonempty below; each accepted position increments limitsummons BEFORE <=15 gate. Active summon chain: Dreadnought1/70; else guaranteed nextInt(1,1)==1 enters nested Prowler1/100 (+attempted zoniex:tormented_steve command at recipient origin), else sequential1/2 rolls select RandomTermite/ScorpionStriker, CentipedeStalker+EvictorLarvae, or SpiderFunnel. Trailing Hornet/Mosquito/Fly loop is unreachable behind the guaranteed1..1 branch. Spider rain additionally needs Moth advancement/map flag, armor>1 and cycle<fresh1..1000: one position X/Z[-40,40], Y[30,60], empty; local summonsdone increments once (<=12 is ineffective here), limitsummons<=100 before choice Brood1/10, else LongLegs1/5, else Larvae; counter increments after spawn attempt.
